notes: Confirmed from official NEC/Sharp NEC User's Manual (PA1004UL-W/PA1004UL-B, PA804UL-W/PA804UL-B), Ver.1 6/20, plus ProjectorCentral spec table for HDMI version confirmation. Terminal panel and connector list apply identically to the -W (white) and -B (black) color variants and to the lower-lumen PA804UL sibling. HDMI confirmed as HDMI 2.0 w/ HDCP 2.2 per ProjectorCentral (manual states 4K/HDR/3D support + HDCP 2.2 but does not print "2.0" literally). DisplayPort data rate of 5.4/2.7/1.62 Gbps corresponds to DisplayPort 1.2 (HBR2); manual does not print the DP version number explicitly, so this is a close inference, not a direct quote. HDBaseT (RJ-45 IN and OUT) ports are not bandwidth-graded in the connector taxonomy provided (no HDBaseT grade scale exists), so grade is omitted for them; they support up to 4K/HDR/3D at up to 300 MHz pixel clock over 100BASE-TX. Ethernet/LAN RJ-45 port supports 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX (eth-100m). No dedicated composite/component RCA jacks - the 15-pin mini D-Sub also accepts component (YPbPr) via adapter, so it is not a separate port. USB-A port is service/firmware-update only (not a full USB host for playback) but is wired as a generic USB-A port; direction set to bidirectional per instruction (USB host ports = bidirectional). PC Control uses a D-Sub 9-pin (RS-232) connector. 3D Sync uses a Mini DIN 3-pin connector, mapped to the closest available connector id (midi-din) since no dedicated mini-DIN-3 id exists - noted as an approximation. AC power inlet type is not explicitly pictured/labeled with a connector standard in the manual (it just shows "supplied power cord's three-pin plug"); given the 100-240V/750-845W rating and typical NEC installation-projector design, this is a standard IEC C13/C14 inlet - set as iec with medium confidence for that one port. Rack units omitted: this is a desktop/ceiling-mount projector, not rack-mountable. Lens is sold separately (bayonet-mount, multiple options) and is not counted as a port.

ports.name: COMPUTER IN
ports.note: Mini D-Sub 15-pin; also accepts analog RGB or component (YPbPr) video

ports.name: HDBaseT IN/Ethernet
ports.note: HDBaseT video/audio input over RJ-45, 100BASE-TX; supports 4K/HDR/3D, up to 300 MHz pixel clock; no HDBaseT grade tier applies

ports.name: HDBaseT OUT/Ethernet
ports.note: HDBaseT video/audio loop-through output for daisy-chaining projectors, 100BASE-TX

ports.name: REMOTE
ports.note: Stereo mini jack for wired remote control

ports.name: 3D SYNC
ports.note: Mini DIN 3-pin, 5V/10mA sync output for 3D emitter; closest available connector id, not an exact match

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: 100-240V AC 50/60Hz; three-pin power cord inlet, exact IEC connector class (C13/C14 vs C19) not explicitly pictured in manual
